title: flagstaff plugin
description: A plugin is one plain object. Everything in it is data that can be read without running it; the only functions allowed are a component's `static` (required) and `frame` (optional). A spinner or component without a static projection is refused at register().

name.description: The plugin's name; also the prefix a host may use when two plugins contribute the same key.

contract.description: The plugin contract this object follows. A host refuses a newer contract than it knows.

tokens.description: A roundel theme: semantic token name to a hex colour, contrast-checked when flown.

glyphs.description: Symbols by meaning: `ok`, `fail`, `warn`, `info`, `running`. A plugin that ships glyphs changes every built-in that draws one.

spinners.description: Spinner styles by name, in cli-spinners' shape plus the static projection.

borders.description: Border styles a box can be drawn with, by name.

components.description: Components by name: `static(state)` returns the text a pipe, an agent or a screen reader gets; `frame(t, state)` is the optional animated form.

interval.description: Milliseconds between frames on a terminal.

static.description: What a pipe prints instead of the animation.
(state) => string. Required: the projection every non-terminal mode prints.

frame.description: (t, state) => string. Optional: the frame at t milliseconds since hoisting.

interval.description: Milliseconds between repaints when `frame` is given; 80 when omitted.

border.description: cli-boxes' shape exactly, so that corpus imports unchanged.
